title: Smart Data Models - MTConnect - DataItem
description: Information reported about a piece of equipment. (MTConnect 2.8, SysML model class DataItem; JSON Schema MTConnectDevices_2.8.schema.json; property names kept verbatim, deprecated properties and codes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity, urn:ngsi-ld:DataItem:<...>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataItem'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

category.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#category'. Specifies the kind of information provided by a data item.

compositionId.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#compositionId'. Identifier attribute of the Composition that the reported data is most closely associated.

discrete.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#discrete'. Indication signifying whether each value reported for the Observation is significant and whether duplicate values are to be suppressed. If a value is not defined for DataItem::discrete, the default value MUST be false.

mtconnectId.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#id'. MTConnect 'id' (renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD). Unique identifier for this data item.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#name'. Name of the data item.

nativeScale.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#nativeScale'. Used to convert the reported value to represent the original measured value.

nativeUnits.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#nativeUnits'. Native units of measurement for the reported value of the data item.

sampleRate.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#sampleRate'. Rate at which successive samples of a data item are recorded by a piece of equipment.

significantDigits.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#significantDigits'. Number of significant digits in the reported value.

statistic.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#statistic'. Type of statistical calculation performed on a series of data samples to provide the reported data value.

dataItemType.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#type'. MTConnect 'type' (renamed because 'type' is reserved in NGSI-LD). Type of data being measured. See DataItem Types.

units.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#units'. Unit of measurement for the reported value of the data item.

representation.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#representation'. Description of a means to interpret data consisting of multiple data points or samples reported as a single value. If DataItem::representation is not specified, it MUST be determined to be VALUE.

Source.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#hasSource'. Identifies the Component, DataItem, or Composition from which a measured value originates.

Constraints.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#hasConstraint'. Organizes a set of expected values that can be reported for a DataItem.

InitialValue.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#hasInitialValue'. Starting value for a DataItem as well as the value to be set for the DataItem after a reset event.

ResetTrigger.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#hasResetTrigger'. Type of event that may cause a reset to occur.

Definition.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#hasDefinition'. Defines the meaning of Entry and Cell entities when the associated DataItem::representation is either DATA_SET or TABLE.

coordinateSystemIdRef.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#coordinateSystemIdRef'. Associated CoordinateSystem context for the DataItem.

isDataItemOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/DeviceInformationModel/DataItems/DataItem/#isDataItemOf'. Component or Device that this DataItem belongs to (in MTConnect documents, the element that contains it in its DataItems). Reference to a Component or Device entity.

name.description: Name of the Component. When provided, Component::name MUST be unique for all child Component entities of a parent Component.

sampleInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds between the completion of the reading of the data associated with the Component until the beginning of the next sampling of that data. This information may be used by client software applications to understand how often information from a Component is expected to be refreshed. The refresh rate for data from all child Component entities will be the same as for the parent Component element unless specifically overridden by another Component::sampleInterval provided for the child Component.

uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for the Component.

coordinateSystemIdRef.description: Specifies the CoordinateSystem for this Component and its children.

DataItem.description: Information reported about a piece of equipment.

category.description: Specifies the kind of information provided by a data item.

compositionId.description: Identifier attribute of the Composition that the reported data is most closely associated.

discrete.description: Indication signifying whether each value reported for the Observation is significant and whether duplicate values are to be suppressed. If a value is not defined for DataItem::discrete, the default value MUST be false.

id.description: Unique identifier for this data item.

name.description: Name of the data item.

nativeScale.description: Used to convert the reported value to represent the original measured value.

nativeUnits.description: Native units of measurement for the reported value of the data item.

sampleRate.description: Rate at which successive samples of a data item are recorded by a piece of equipment.

significantDigits.description: Number of significant digits in the reported value.

statistic.description: Type of statistical calculation performed on a series of data samples to provide the reported data value.

type.description: Type of data being measured. See DataItem Types.

units.description: Unit of measurement for the reported value of the data item.

representation.description: Description of a means to interpret data consisting of multiple data points or samples reported as a single value. If DataItem::representation is not specified, it MUST be determined to be VALUE.

coordinateSystemIdRef.description: Associated CoordinateSystem context for the DataItem.

InitialValue.description: Starting value for a DataItem as well as the value to be set for the DataItem after a reset event.

ResetTrigger.description: Type of event that may cause a reset to occur.

Definition.description: Defines the meaning of Entry and Cell entities when the associated DataItem::representation is either DATA_SET or TABLE.

units.description: Same as DataItem::units. See Value Properties of DataItem.

key.description: Unique identification of the Cell in the Definition. The description applies to all Cell observations having this CellDefinition::key.

type.description: Same as DataItem::type. See DataItem Types.

keyType.description: DataItem::type that defines the meaning of CellDefinition::key.

key.description: Unique identification of the Entry in the Definition. The description applies to all Entry observations having this EntryDefinition::key.

units.description: Same as DataItem::units. See Value Properties of DataItem.

type.description: Same as DataItem::type. See DataItem Types.

keyType.description: DataItem::type that defines the meaning of EntryDefinition::key.

AbstractDataItemRelationship.description: Association between a DataItem and another entity.

idRef.description: Reference to the related entity's id.

name.description: Descriptive name associated with this AbstractDataItemRelationship.
